node.statement: The hypotheses of lem-residual-upper hold for C, b_j=a_j^+ on j notin G, c_j=a_j^- on all rows, p_j the corresponding rows, r_j the corresponding negative-source rows, m=1-sigma_g, and D_j=2+4*delta: all coefficients are nonnegative, q has the required quotient form, and node 1.1.3 supplies ||x-r_j||_1<=D_j for every x in C.
